flowable.multiInstance.collection.toolti: Read from a variable, e.g. assigneeList. Candidate users can also be fetched with {'${execution.getCurrentFlowElement().getCandidateUsers()}'}
flowable.multiInstance.elementVariable.t: Name of the variable holding the element taken from the collection; can be used to set the assignee, e.g. assignee
flowable.multiInstance.completionConditi: Expressions are supported. Built-in variables: nrOfInstances (total instances), nrOfActiveInstances (active instances), nrOfCompletedInstances (completed instances), e.g. {'${nrOfCompletedInstances/nrOfInstances >= 0.6}'} or {'${multiInstance.complete(execution, 60)}'}
flowable.timer.timeDate.tooltip: Time at which execution starts, e.g. 2011-03-11T12:13:14
flowable.timer.timeDuration.tooltip: How long to wait before execution starts. Format: P[n]Y[n]M[n]DT[n]H[n]M[n]S, where P = period, T = time, and the rest are years, months, days, hours, minutes and seconds, e.g. P3D (3 days), P1D12H (1 day 12 hours), PT10M (10 minutes)
flowable.timer.timeCycle.tooltip: Format: Rn/{'<'}interval{'>'}, e.g. R3/PT5M (repeat 3 times, once every 5 minutes); or a CRON expression, e.g. 0 0/5 * * * ? (every 5 minutes)
flowable.listener.execution.type.class.t: Fully qualified Java class name, e.g. com.example.MyClass
flowable.listener.execution.type.express: Process variables are available. Default variable: execution (DelegateExecution), e.g. {'${myPojo.myMethod(execution.eventName)}'}
flowable.listener.execution.type.delegat: A bean in the Spring container (no method name needed), e.g. {'${myExecutionListenerBean}'}
flowable.listener.task.type.class.toolti: Fully qualified Java class name, e.g. com.example.MyClass
flowable.listener.task.type.expression.t: Process variables are available. Default variables: execution (DelegateExecution), task (DelegateTask), e.g. {'${myPojo.myMethod(task.eventName)}'}
flowable.listener.task.type.delegateExpr: A bean in the Spring container (no method name needed), e.g. {'${myTaskListenerBean}'}
